source.title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
source.note: Implementation aid derived only from the supplied PDF. Not a substitute for the legal text. Verify current amendments before production legal use.

implementation_principles: Determine applicability before validating a field.
Do not apply one universal checklist to every product.
Use NOT_APPLICABLE where a requirement does not apply.
Image/OCR screening cannot by itself prove actual physical quantity or final legal compliance.
Final legal verification remains with an authorized Legal Metrology officer.
Every finding must retain its rule reference and evidence.

exclusions: Packages containing more than 25 kg or 25 litre, excluding cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50 kg
Packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers

rule_5_standard_packs.description: Commodities in the Second Schedule are to be packed in specified standard quantities.

rules.title: Manufacturer / packer / importer
requirements: manufacturer name and address
packer name and address where manufacturer is not packer
importer name and address for imported package

rules.title: Commodity identity
requirements: common or generic name
for multiple products: name and number or quantity of each product

rules.title: Net quantity
requirements: net quantity
standard unit of weight or measure when sold by weight/measure
number when sold by number

rules.title: Month and year
requirements: month and year of manufacture, pre-packing or import
conditions: Food articles have the stated food-law proviso
Seeds labeled/certified under the stated Seeds Act provisions have the stated proviso
Cosmetics have the stated Drugs and Cosmetics Rules proviso

rules.title: Retail sale price
requirements: retail sale price declaration where applicable

rules.title: Name and address
requirements: conspicuous name and complete address
actual corporate/business name
importer name and complete address for imported packages
where manufactured outside India but packed in India: packer/importer in India on principal display panel
rules.special_case: For packages of capacity 5 cubic cm or less, the stated identification mark/inscription proviso applies.

rules.title: General quantity provisions
requirements: exclude wrappers/non-commodity material from net quantity
quantity should correspond to net quantity received by consumer where environmental variation is not relevant
where negligible variation exists, account for it so consumer receives not less than declared quantity
'when packed' qualification only for significant variation cases specified in Third Schedule

rules.title: Manner of quantity declaration
requirements: accurate and adequate quantity information
mass for solid/semi-solid/viscous/solid-liquid mixture except Fourth Schedule cases
length for linear measure
area for area measure
volume for liquid/cubic measure
number for commodities sold by number
dimensions/number when needed for full information
additional information on same panel
no misleading quantity wording

rules.title: Units

unit_rules.equal_or_more_1_kg: kilogram; fractions may use decimal sub-multiples or grams
unit_rules.equal_or_more_1_m: metre; fractions may use decimal sub-multiples or centimetres
unit_rules.equal_or_more_1_sq_m: square metre; fractions may use decimal sub-multiples
unit_rules.equal_or_more_1_cubic_m: cubic metre; fractions may use decimal sub-multiples
unit_rules.equal_or_more_1_litre: litre; fractions may use decimal sub-multiples

additional: No non-SI system for net quantity
For items sold by number, symbol should be N or U
Dozen, score, gross, great gross or like expressions must not be specified

rules.title: Dimensions of certain commodities
requirements: number and finished-size dimensions
for multiple different dimensions: dimensions and retail sale price of each piece
dimensions and sale price on each individual piece

rules.title: Dimensions/weight related to price
requirements: where dimensions and weight or combination relate to price, declaration includes relevant dimensions/weight/combination

rules.title: Usable sheets
requirements: number of usable sheets
dimensions of each sheet

rules.title: Container-type commodities
requirements: bag type: number of bags plus linear dimensions
rectangular/similar: number plus length, width and depth if required
round: number plus diameter and depth if necessary
where label references relate use to capacity: include relevant standard weight/measure

rules.title: Wholesale/retail dealer provisions
requirements: packaged commodity offered/sold/stored should comply
sale price must not exceed retail sale price
retail sale price must not be obliterated, smudged or altered
manufacturer/packer/importer must not alter printed price on wrapper once printed and used for packing

rules.title: Inspection at manufacturer/packer
requirements: authorized person may examine/test packages
sampling per Fifth Schedule
tests per Sixth Schedule
report records declarations, actual net quantity and extent of error

rules.title: Action after inspection
requirements: procedure applies where statistical average is below declared quantity
procedure applies where deficiency exceeds maximum permissible error
procedure applies where required declarations are absent
rules.prototype_use: Officer workflow guidance only; do not automate punitive/legal action.

rules.title: Inspection at wholesale/retail premises
requirements: tests ordinarily not carried out except listed conditions
verify quantity against declaration
compare deficiency with maximum permissible error
missing declarations may lead to source enquiries

rules.title: Maximum permissible error
requirements: use First Schedule
consider unavoidable weighing/measuring/counting variation
consider ordinary climate/transport/storage variation
consider packaging/container effects

rules.title: Deceptive packages
requirements: where quantity agrees but package is deceptive, repacking/relabeling may be required
deceptive package means a package designed to give an exaggerated or misleading impression of quantity
rules.prototype_use: Potential issue requiring officer review; image alone should not conclusively determine deception.

rules.title: Wholesale package declarations
requirements: legible, definite, plain and conspicuous declaration
manufacturer/importer name and address or packer where applicable
identity of commodity
total number of retail packages or net quantity in standard units

rules.title: Export packages sold in India
requirements: export package must be repacked or relabeled according to Chapter II before sale in India

rules.title: Exemptions
conditions: net weight/measure 10 g or 10 ml or less, subject to the stated proviso for 10g–20g / 10ml–20ml MRP and net quantity
fast food items packed by restaurant/hotel and the like
scheduled and non-scheduled formulations covered by the stated Drugs (Price Control) Order
agricultural farm produce in packages above 50 kg as stated in the PDF

rules.title: Advertisement mentioning retail sale price
requirements: advertisement mentioning retail sale price must declare net quantity or number
font size of net quantity in advertisement must be same as retail sale price

checks: declaration should not require reading through liquid commodity
outside container/wrapper requirements subject to stated transparency proviso
Hindi (Devanagari) or English permitted; other languages may be additional
presentation_checks.automation_policy: Use computer vision as screening. Mark precise font-size/physical-measurement questions UNCERTAIN when image quality cannot establish them.

maximum_permissible_error.rounding: For percentage errors, the supplied First Schedule states rounding to nearest one-tenth g/ml up to 1000 g/ml and next whole g/ml above 1000 g/ml.

second_schedule_verified_examples.commodity: Rice (powdered), flour, atta, rawa and suji

third_schedule_when_packed_verified: cream other than cream of milk

sixth_schedule_physical_measurement.weight: Suitable working standard weights/balances or other suitable declared measures; equipment should function properly.
sixth_schedule_physical_measurement.liquid_volume: Appropriate volume measurement or applicable weight/specific-gravity method.
sixth_schedule_physical_measurement.length: Calibrated steel tape or suitable calibrated instrument.
sixth_schedule_physical_measurement.number: Actual counting; packages may be opened.
sixth_schedule_physical_measurement.prototype_rule: Do not claim camera OCR measures actual contents. Provide officer measurement mode.

scoring.important: The supplied Rules do not define a 0-100 compliance score. SmartPack may calculate a screening/risk score, but it must not be presented as a statutory legal score.
